response.content: {"critique": "The problem is that supplier list changes disrupt reporting flows and force users to share sensitive details for diagnosis. The closest item, story 4129 'Supplier contact details' (completed 2026-09-15), only covers automatic syncing of supplier contact info and does not address reporting disruption or diagnostic privacy. The Notion 'Supplier directory' roadmap page is about a searchable supplier directory, not reporting adaptation, and the remaining stories (activity timeline, task list, reporting navigation) are unrelated with very low similarity. No shipped story or roadmap item solves this core problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
